messages.subject: Stan language support for Atom
parts: For those users of the Atom editor, there's the package language-Stan now provides support for syntax highlighting, folding, and few config options for the Stan language: https://atom.io/packages/language-stan. If you find any bugs, file them at the github page: https://github.com/jrnold/atom-language-stan. Pull requests welcome!
